id: title:Gilbert09:classify denied s3 writes in the v3 pipeline writer

review.posthog_relevance: Changes exception handling in warehouse schema writing to distinguish permission-denied errors, raising a typed ObjectStorePermissionDeniedError instead of a generic exception. This could help PostHog error tracking and customer-facing diagnostics distinguish warehouse access issues from other failures.
review.reason: Adds typed exception and helper to handle S3 permission errors. P1.F2.H3: Replaces generic Exception with ObjectStorePermissionDeniedError for warehouse access failures. This improves diagnostic specificity for warehouse ingestion, a core PostHog warehouse product capability.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a more specific exception type, which supports better diagnostics. However, the actual benefit depends on whether this change is adopted and used by warehouse-dependent customers, and whether the broader context of warehouse ingestion and recovery is fully represented. No unverified outcomes or adoption are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader context and tier eligibility.
